summary: Mowe Lake tower near Thunder Bay; only an undated independent list names it among still-standing towers, and no source gives its history or condition today.

facts.status_note: Named on an undated independent list of still-standing towers; no later source confirms it.

evidence.supports: Location in the Thunder Bay area
Mowe Lake Tower named on the still-standing list, at Thunder Bay
evidence.quote: Mowe Lake Tower- Thunder Bay, Ont.

evidence.supports: Title of the list is Ontario Fire Towers Still Standing

notes_for_editor: The only source naming this tower as standing is an independent list that carries no date. It says the MNR decided 'as of 2013' to remove many still-standing towers, but does not say whether Mowe Lake was among them; no later source was found. Firelookout.ca has the location and coordinates only (no build date, height, type, status or access). A YouTube video titled 'Climbing Mowe Lake Fire Tower' is described in search results as about one of Ontario's abandoned towers, which conflicts with the list; the video page had no readable description, so it is not cited. The brief has no local_unit for this tower, so none is given. Two searches were used. Status 'standing' rests on one undated list; treat as unverified before publishing.
